prompts.ninja: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character layered animation atlas, transparent PNG, 1536x1024 landscape. Original young athletic ninja hero, spiky charcoal hair, amber headband with no logo, uncovered intense expressive face, dark indigo tactical jacket with rich amber panels and subtle teal details, wrapped forearms, dark fitted trousers, shin guards and dark ninja boots. This is a modular cutout rig texture atlas, NOT a whole character or illustration. EXACT layout: FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, twelve isolated body-part tiles, every part wholly inside its tile with generous transparent padding; NO grid lines, NO labels, NO writing. Row 1 left to right: head facing right three-quarter side profile including hair and jaw; sleeveless torso facing slightly right from shoulders to belt with no arms/head; pelvis/waist clothing only; a short skin neck. Row 2: single upper arm pointing straight down shoulder at top; single forearm pointing straight down elbow at top; clenched right-facing fist; boot viewed side-on pointing RIGHT. Row 3: single upper thigh pointing straight down; single shin pointing straight down; a second expression of the same head with teeth gritted facing right; a short flowing amber scarf separate. Natural believable anatomy, generous overlapping joint ends for animation, clean alpha cutout edges, consistent soft moonlit teal rim lighting and warm key light from upper left. Rich tactile woven cloth, leather edge wear and subtle skin shading, crisp confident illustrated features; premium fighting-game concept art, not flat vector art, not pixel art, not plastic 3D, no thick black angular outlines, no shadows cast on the background. All blank space must be genuinely transparent with alpha. Do not connect parts to one another. No human full body. No extra limbs in a tile.
